text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B.---!
She claims the glorious shield with absolute brilliance!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...*Pant*, *pant*, *pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu... Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Nn... Man, C.B. really is strong!
Guess I gotta rethink my training routine.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"—Man, that Tenno Sho (Autumn) was awesome!
CB's races are always so strong and exciting!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I get that it's interesting, but... when it
comes down to 'strength,' it's gotta be Rudolf.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
She's definitely an Umamusume who will forge the legend
of the next generation. After all, she's an undefeated Triple Crown winner!
The Triple Crown alone is already incredible, but...

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: You got that right. With her, she might really become an Umamusume who surpasses the "myth"!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"...First CB, then Rudolf.
Hey, I was there today too, y'know!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Just shows how big of a deal they really are.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Phew! Next time for sure, I'll carve into their minds
the sight of Katsuragi Ace...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After the Tenno Sho (Autumn)—
Mr. C.B. was running across the grounds.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah, haah, haah!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Ran and ran! Ah, that was so much fun!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Trainer!
I told you you could just go home!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She did say that.
Come to think of it, though, we hadn't decided on our next target race yet.
choice_data_list: I wanted to decide on a target race.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "There's no problem waiting until tomorrow or later, but... there's no harm in hearing what you want early."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see.
So that's why you were waiting for me.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"The next race, huh... If it's the Japan Cup,
I wonder if Ace... and Rudolf will run, too?"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
The winner of that race is always a foreign Umamusume.
No Japanese Umamusume has ever won it yet.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"If she wins, she'll be the first Umamusume from Japan to conquer the world.
Would she really let that crown slip away—?"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Sorry, but I'm thinking of sitting this one out.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Oh, Rudolf's got sharp ears as always.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Whenever my name is called, you see. Pardon me for cutting in.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
So...
Are you not running in the Japan Cup?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"As I am now, I don't think I'll be in top form in time.
Considering what I'm aiming for, I want to avoid defeat."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Come on now. Did you go and
put a mask over your heart too?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Let's keep it simple and just get excited!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
No, forgive me.
I am currently halfway along the path to becoming "Emperor."
I wish to proceed with caution.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Let's meet again at Nakayama at the end of the year.
C.B.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...I see. Understood.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
“The 『Arima Kinen』 is a promise, okay?
We're definitely running it together!”

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you. I give you my word.
Until next time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Expectations are soaring for a Japanese Uma Musume to take the crown in this year's Japan Cup!
I need to keep fine-tuning my training for the fierce battle ahead!
